purpose: Expose the existing pure-read SuccessMemory synthesis through the Song experience so the artist can see when an exact change has prior supporting, counterexample, inconclusive or pending Learning evidence, together with sample size, conditions, alternative explanations and confidence, without turning association into a success rule.

lineage.outcome: The artist can recognize what comparable past work suggests, including counterexamples and uncertainty, instead of relying on vague memory or a fake universal recipe.
lineage.capability: Consumer-readable Success Memory with association-only humility

why_now: REQ-SCOPE-139 is a required minimum whose CORE-02E SuccessMemory foundation is already implemented. SONG-LEARNING-01 now gives the normal artist a consumer path that can populate those patterns, making read-only pattern recall immediately useful rather than an empty backend projection.
instead_of: Friction Memory consumer UX is not selected first because normal artist authority to record explicit friction observations is still missing; recurring-pattern display alone would often be empty.
DO IT/WITH ME/SHOW ME modes still require a distinct collaboration-depth product model.
First-class References still require a new persistent Reference subsystem.
Full A/B and derivation remain blocked on truthful analysis substrate.
More Learning write controls are not selected because the just-landed change→observation→decision loop is already consumer-reachable and Success recall is a separate read outcome.
completion_proof: the normal /song surface can show exact-pattern Learning synthesis for the active Song without creating or mutating Success state
each pattern shows the concrete domain, subject and change plus completed sample size and pending evidence count
KEEP support, REVERT/REVISE counterexamples and INCONCLUSIVE evidence remain visibly distinct
the canonical humility warning is visible and no UI language claims causation, universal success or guaranteed future performance
conditions and alternative explanations/confounders remain visible with recurrence counts instead of being stripped from the pattern
observation and decision confidence are summarized without exposing episode IDs or source references
patterns with one retained example, success-only evidence, mixed evidence, no keep evidence, inconclusive-only evidence and no completed evidence degrade truthfully
GET reads are pure; Song, Session, Learning, Skill, Focus, Operations, DAWs and providers remain unchanged
quit/relaunch preserves the same derived result because the view is recomputed from canonical LearningMemory
authored proof remains separate from executed evidence; absent hosted execution is UNOBSERVED
next_selection_rule: After landing or blockage, globally reselect across Friction capture/reachability, interaction/teaching modes, References, Compare/A-B, Creative Studio, audio-analysis substrate, DAW/OPS and other portfolio outcomes.
